summary_md: This looks high-impact (auth/payments/sends/migrations). The lane planned it but paused for your go before doing anything. Plan: ## Plan for ARCA-61 — Saved watchlists not persisting  ### What I found before proposing anything I read the full path end-to-end without changing anything: `WatchlistPage.tsx` → `client/src/lib/api.ts` → `modules/watchlist/handlers.ts` → `db/auth.ts` / schema.  **The code, as written today, looks correctly wired:** - The client has no localStorage/anonymous fallback anywhere — every read and write goes through `api.get`/`api.post` against `/watchlist`. - `api.ts` sends `credentials: "include"` on every request, and errors are surfaced (toast), not swallowed. - Every watchlist route
